newsitem.title: USA: Hedstrom to pay $11.25/cash for ERO Inc.
newsitem.headline: Hedstrom to pay $11.25/cash for ERO Inc.

text.p: Privately held Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc said Friday that its Hedstrom Corp of Pittsburgh has agreed to acquire ERO Inc of Mount Prospect, Ill., a manufacturer of children's leisure and activity products, in a transaction valued at about $203 million.
Hicks, Muse said it expects the transaction to be complete within 60 days.

Under terms of the definitive agreement between Hedstrom and ERO, Hedstrom will pay $11.25 per share in cash, or about $123 million, for the equity of ERO and refinance ERO's existing debt of about $80 million, Hicks, Muse said.
ERO's board unanimously approved the transaction and recommended approval of the transaction by ERO's shareholders, Hicks, Muse said.
